instruction.name: xvsigncov.d
instruction.description: If the 64-bit element in `a` equals to zero, set the result to zero. If the signed 64-bit element in `a` is positive, copy element in `b` to result. Otherwise, copy negated element in `b` to result. If `a` and `b` are the same vectors, it is equivalent to computing absolute value.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
